title: Alcatraz Declassified: The 17 FBI Files That Prove They Survived (Full Documentary)
description:
Everyone knows the official story of June 11, 1962: three bank robbers scraped through Alcatraz concrete with cafeteria spoons, placed papier-mâché dummy heads in their bunks, and drowned in 52°F San Francisco Bay. That is the version J. Edgar Hoover needed America to believe.

Inside 17 volumes of declassified FBI Vault files, suppressed San Francisco Police Department harbor logs, hydrodynamic supercomputer tide reconstructions, and a classified 2013 confession letter kept secret until 2018, a startlingly different story emerges.

In this 11-minute investigative documentary combining 3D Amber Noir reenactments, original June 1962 & March 1963 National Archives newsreels, and real declassified FBI memoranda, we examine every buried clue:
• The raw saltwater plumbing flaw & 90°F shower policy that backfired
• Coin-silver brazed spoons, the 6:00 PM Music Hour electric vacuum drill & 212°F steam-pipe raft vulcanization
• Cell B-136: Why fourth conspirator Allen Clayton West sealed himself inside with Portland cement — and whether his 'Angel Island' confession sent 100 FBI agents the wrong way
• The 2014 Delft University tidal model proving a single 45-minute slack-tide corridor (11:30 PM – Midnight) carried a raft straight to Horseshoe Bay
• SFPD Officer Robert Checchi's suppressed 1:00 AM sighting of an unlit white cabin cruiser off Alcatraz
• Marin County's stolen blue 1955 Chevrolet (California plate KPB-076) vs. the Norwegian freighter SS Norefjell body sighting
• 11 years of anonymous Mother's Day roses, the 1973 Florida funeral disguise & Fred Brizzi's 1975 Brazil ranch Kodachrome analyzed by forensic specialist Michael Streed
• The unsealed 2013 SFPD Richmond Station 'John Anglin' cancer letter & why RFK shut Alcatraz down forever just 283 days after the escape
